ja: 戻ったら、これコピーしとくね。
en: I'll copy this when I'm back.
alternatives: When I'm back, I'll copy this.
I'll copy this once I'm back.
point: 「戻ったら」は未来でも when 節は現在形

ja: 新人は毎朝、みんなに挨拶しながら入ってくる。
en: The new hire walks in greeting everyone every morning.
alternatives: Every morning, the new hire walks in greeting everyone.
The new hire comes in greeting everybody every morning.
point: 「挨拶しながら」は greeting を動詞の後に添えるだけでよい

ja: このプリンター、使っていい？
en: Can I use this printer?
alternatives: Could I use this printer?
May I use this printer?
point: 許可を求めるときは Can I で始める

ja: 少し休憩したほうがいいよ。
en: You should take a break.
alternatives: You should rest a little.
You should take a short break.
point: 「〜したほうがいい」は should + 動詞の原形

ja: 前よりずっと静かだから、つけっぱなしでいいね。
en: It's much quieter now, so we can leave it on.
alternatives: It's a lot quieter, so we can keep it on.
It's far quieter now, so it can stay on.
point: 「ずっと」は very ではなく much で比較級を強める

ja: 来週、田中さんのお帰り会をやるよ。
en: We're throwing Tanaka a welcome-back party next week.
alternatives: We're having a welcome-back party for Tanaka next week.
Next week, we're having a welcome-back party for Tanaka.
point: 決まった予定は現在進行形。throw A B の語順にも注意

ja: エアコンが静かなら、集中できるのに。
en: If the AC were quieter, I could focus.
alternatives: I could concentrate if the AC were quieter.
If the AC were quieter, I could concentrate.
point: 現在の仮定は If + were、主節は would/could

ja: プリンターを詰まらせて放置した人、コーヒーおごってよ。
en: Whoever left the printer jammed owes me a coffee.
alternatives: Whoever jammed the printer and walked away owes me a coffee.
Whoever left the printer jammed should buy me a coffee.
point: 「〜した人は誰でも」は Whoever で主語ごと作れる

ja: カーディガンを持ってくればよかった。寒すぎる。
en: I wish I'd brought a cardigan. I'm freezing.
alternatives: I should've brought a cardigan. I'm freezing.
If only I'd brought a cardigan. I'm freezing.
point: 過去の後悔は I wish I brought ではなく I wish I'd brought

ja: 昨日決まったこと、まだ聞いてないよ。
en: I haven't heard what was decided yesterday.
alternatives: I haven't been told what was decided yesterday.
I haven't heard what got decided yesterday.
point: 「まだ聞いていない」は現在完了、「決まったこと」は what 節

ja: 彼女が言ってくれたら、皆で代われたのに。
en: If she'd told us, we'd have stepped in.
alternatives: If she'd told us, we'd have covered for her.
If she'd told us, we would have helped out.
If she'd told us, we could've covered for her.
point: 過去の仮定は if＋had 過去分詞、would have＋過去分詞

ja: あそこでコピーを取っている人は誰？
en: Who's the person making copies over there?
alternatives: Who's that person over there making copies?
Who's that over there at the copier?
point: 「人」を後ろから making で説明する

ja: 帰るとき、電気を消してね。
en: Turn off the lights when you leave.
alternatives: Please turn off the lights when leaving.
When you leave, turn off the lights.
point: 電気を「消す」は turn off、原形で始める

ja: 田中さんは今日お休みです。
en: Tanaka is off today.
alternatives: Tanaka is out today.
Tanaka isn't in today.
point: 「休み」は off で表せる。holiday は不要

ja: 先週、紙を多めに注文しておくべきだった。
en: I should have ordered more paper last week.
alternatives: I should've ordered extra paper last week.
I should've placed a bigger paper order last week.
point: 「すべきだった」は should have＋過去分詞

ja: 朝からずっと IT に電話してるけど、誰も出ない。
en: I've been calling IT all morning, but nobody answers.
alternatives: I've been trying IT all morning, but no one's answering.
I've been calling IT all morning, but nobody picks up.
point: 朝からずっと続く動作は I've been calling の現在完了進行形

ja: 去年の忘年会の幹事、今どの部署にいるか知ってる？
en: Any idea which department last year's party organizer is in?
alternatives: Do you know where last year's party organizer works now?
Any idea what department last year's party planner works in?
point: 間接疑問は which department の後が平叙文の語順

ja: ケンが辞めていなければ、今は人手不足じゃないのに。
en: If Ken hadn't quit, we wouldn't be short-staffed now.
alternatives: If Ken hadn't left, we wouldn't be understaffed now.
We wouldn't be short-staffed now if Ken hadn't quit.
point: 過去が原因で今の結果は wouldn't be、時制を混ぜる

ja: 昨日、ここに傘を忘れたんです。
en: I left my umbrella here yesterday.
alternatives: I forgot my umbrella here yesterday.
Yesterday, I left my umbrella here.
point: 「忘れる」は場所を言うなら forgot より left が自然

ja: みんな、もう机の片付けは終わった？
en: Have you all finished cleaning your desks?
alternatives: Are you all done cleaning your desks?
Has everyone finished tidying their desks?
point: finish の後ろは to 不定詞でなく動名詞

ja: 給湯室に誰かのお弁当がありますよ。
en: There's someone's lunch in the kitchen.
alternatives: Someone's lunch is in the kitchen.
Someone left their lunch in the kitchen.
point: 「ある」は There is で表せる

ja: 金曜は休みを取ると、課長に伝えておいたよ。
en: I told my manager I'd be taking Friday off.
alternatives: I let my manager know I'd be off Friday.
I told my manager I was taking Friday off.
point: 時制の一致で will は would に変わる

ja: このファイル、開けないんです。
en: I can't open this file.
alternatives: This file won't open.
I'm not able to open this file.
point: 「開けない」は can't open で表す

ja: ここにあったホッチキス、誰か見た？
en: Anyone seen the stapler that was here?
alternatives: Has anyone seen the stapler that was here?
Did anybody see the stapler that was here?
point: 物を後ろから that was here で説明する

ja: 会社に着いたら、紙はもう切れていた。
en: The paper had run out when I arrived.
alternatives: We'd run out of paper when I arrived.
The paper was already gone when I arrived.
point: 到着より前の出来事は had run out で表す

ja: ITにノートPCを設定してもらった。
en: I had IT set up my laptop.
alternatives: I got IT to set up my laptop.
IT set up my laptop for me.
point: have＋人＋動詞の原形。get なら to が要る

ja: 惜しい、彼女なら5分前に席を外したところだよ。
en: Just missed her; she stepped out five minutes ago.
alternatives: Just missed her; she stepped away five minutes ago.
Too bad, she stepped out five minutes ago.
point: 「〜したところ」でも five minutes ago があれば過去形 (stepped out)

ja: コピー用紙はどこですか？
en: Where is the copy paper?
alternatives: Where is the printer paper?
Where can I find copy paper?
point: paper は数えられないので is を使う

ja: 私が頼んだ付箋、届いた？
en: Did the sticky notes I ordered arrive?
alternatives: Did the sticky notes I ordered come in?
Have the sticky notes I ordered arrived?
point: 名詞のあとに「I ordered」を置いて後ろから修飾する
